name: Siansa Analysis
author: Siansa
description: For the Siansa app: measures each song's loudness and how it starts and ends (levelling and SmoothFade), and finds similar albums and artists from AudioMuse-AI's sound analysis.

versions.changelog: First public version of Siansa Analysis: volume and fade profiles for levelling and SmoothFade, and similar albums and artists from AudioMuse-AI's sound analysis.
Songs with a few damaged bits are measured instead of failing, and songs not on the music server are looked at once a day instead of every round.
Import from Lumae: a one-time copy of the volume and fade profiles Lumae already measured (removed again in 0.1.3).
Measure all songs at once (with a warning), shorter rounds so AudioMuse can start its own jobs, and reloading the settings page no longer starts a job again.
First version: volume and fade profiles, similar albums and artists, each with its own progress.
